svg.title: Inaudible channels (18–19.5 kHz): success vs SNR
svg.text: Inaudible channels (18–19.5 kHz): success vs SNR
32-byte ASCII payload, AWGN, 48 kHz, 1 transmission, 50 trials per point
ggwave DT/MT moved to start at 18 kHz (custom configuration), receiver restricted to them
MT in fixed-length mode (receiver knows the length)
SNR (dB): sound-on signal power / white-noise power in 0–24 kHz
